player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee leek {player_id} ee kuɔny {num_rounds} ee kuɔny Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Yin adhiɛɛr ee men kuɔny kɔ̈ɔ̈c tɛ̈ɛ̈n.
Kɔ̈ɔ̈c kuɔny, kuɛɛr ee kɔ̈k: '[rock]', '[paper]', ku '[scissors]'.
Yin ee kuɛɛr '[r]', '[p]', ku '[s]' ee kɔ̈k kɔ̈ɔ̈c.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kuɛɛr ee kɔ̈ɔ̈c acɔl. Kuɛɛr [rock], [paper], ku [scissors].

message.round_draw: Kë cï bɛ̈n bei në ye abak yic: Dɛ̈t.
message.round_win: Kë cï bɛ̈n bei: Raan ye wɛ̈t kän gam ë {winner}!

outcome.p0_wins: Raan ye 0 yen acï wëu juëc apɛi bɛ̈n tiaam!
outcome.p1_wins: Raan ye 1 acï wëu juëc apɛi bɛ̈n tiaam!
outcome.draw: Ee yic, ee yen kë cï rot looi!
